title: Work Light for Makita Battery – 15 LEDs with USB Ports
descriptionHtml:
The headlamp blinds and the phone dies

Under the car, in the shed, at the garden cabin after dark – the light is always pointing the wrong way, and the battery you already own is sitting in the drill doing nothing.

The light powered by the battery you already have

A work light with 15 LEDs that clicks straight onto the Makita 18V mount. Carry handle, stable base and two USB ports so the phone charges while you work. Battery not included – that's the whole point: you already have it.

Features

  • Lights up the whole work area – 15 LEDs with wide light instead of a narrow beam
  • Clicks straight onto the battery you own – fits the Makita 18V mount
  • Charges your phone at the same time – two USB ports in the base
  • Goes wherever the job is – carry handle, 16 cm tall
  • Battery not included – the light runs on your own Makita 18V battery

Change of mind

You have 14 days to change your mind, counted from the day you receive the item.
